problems.what: docli add https://trpc.io/docs fetched only a 7-file landing page (2.1k tokens) with no httpBatchLink content, although the help says to give the page that holds the docs. It reported success and 'coverage ok', so nothing signals the page is a landing page; no data.suggestions or hint appeared. I only learned it from the later search hint. Workaround was guessing https://trpc.io/llms-full.txt, which worked.
Multi-word search returns no matches, so it appears to be exact-phrase rather than all-terms.
Search for 'import httpBatchLink' returns unrelated sections (Suspense, aborting calls) with no import of httpBatchLink, so I needed grep on the files to confirm the package.
The workflow rule forbids reading files outside docli, yet I used cat and grep on .docli files. The task allows 'files it writes', but `docli show` would have been cleaner.
